text:
Lena (CSM): Heads up — Asterion Labs showing abrupt drop in request volume for the /generate route: DAU down ~52% last 7d. Renewal in ~5 weeks. Can we triage? Dashboard: https://redwood.app/metrics/asterion

Jared (RevOps): saw the alert. Billing spike last month then a sharp fall. No invoice disputes but CFO asked about unit costs.

Priya (AE): Who's the internal owner? Any new contacts?

Lena (CSM): Champion (Ibrahim) moved to new role two weeks ago. New contact is PM Talia — low engagement so far. They mentioned trying a competitor POC last week (unknown vendor).

Nate (Eng): Quick checks: infra shows a client-side concurrency cap applied from their side on 1755009000 — could explain fewer concurrent sessions. No service 500s.

Marta (Support): Filed ticket S-7210 and emailed Talia for repro + sample payloads. She said the squad applied a config to batch size and reduced max_tokens to cut costs.

Priya (AE): If champion left and they're testing competitors, we should prioritize an exec touch and an offer to stabilize. Proposal: 45-day Dedicated trial with throughput credits. Thoughts?

Lena (CSM): Customer feedback logs mention "partial completions" and "shortened outputs" in the chat UI. Potentially model truncation, or their client trimming.

Nate (Eng): We rolled an opt-in variant two weeks ago with stricter token budgeting on low-tier routes; that could cause shorter outputs if they hit new cutoffs. I'll confirm if their requests were routed to that variant.

InfraBot: Healthcheck scheduled for Asterion (focus: routing + token-limit tracing). Results will attach to S-7210. ETA 20m.

Jared (RevOps): Quick question for legal/finance — can we do a 45-day reduced-rate Dedicated pilot that includes a one-time credit? I'll start the approval thread.

Marta (Support): Update: Talia sent example request. Sample payload: {"model": "redwood-gen-1.4", "prompt": "Summarize...", "max_tokens": 128, "batch_size": 1} She noted responses sometimes cut off mid-sentence.

Nate (Eng): That payload + lower max_tokens matches the variant behavior. If their client lowered batch_size and we routed to the token-tight variant, truncation is expected. We should test re-routing to the previous variant and confirm improvement.

Lena (CSM): Immediate action plan: 1) Priya: exec intro + pilot proposal by EOD; 2) Nate: confirm routing history + try revert test by tomorrow 10am PT; 3) Marta: gather 3 more sample payloads and escalate S-7210; 4) Jared: finance/credits check and legal loop.

Priya (AE): On it — will ask for a 30-min exec call and cc legal. Also prepping a “stability” offer doc.

Marta (Support): I've got Talia on slack — she said infra capped concurrency to 8 while their infra runs a canary. She allowed us temporary bump if we propose minimal risk experiment.

Nate (Eng): Good — if they allow a temporary bump we can A/B route 20% traffic to the previous variant and measure full-output rate + p95. I'll instrument detailed logs.

Jared (RevOps): I'll model the economics for a 45-day pilot with credits and share by 3pm.

Lena (CSM): Owners assigned: Priya (AE) exec + offer; Nate (Eng) routing + revert test; Marta (Support) ticket + payload collection; Jared (RevOps) pricing/credits. Please update thread when tasks complete.

Priya (AE): No objections. I'll try to get an intro to Talia + CFO today.

Nate (Eng): I'll start the revert test once Marta confirms Talia's permission — ETA for first data: tomorrow 10:30am PT.

Marta (Support): Added traces to S-7210 and will post results here. Thanks all. :raised_hands:
